items.title: Stage-H STRICT goal isolation: does silencing the E3 goal term change LEARNED avoidance?
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC (experiment_purpose=diagnostic, claim_ids=[] DELIBERATELY -- a null must not silently re-weight SD-054/MECH-295/307; route interpretation through governance). Measures the DV the 2026-07-27 scaffold goal-freeze triage explicitly left unmeasured: the triage showed the E3 goal term fires on 100% of Stage-H ticks with 0.65x the harm term's candidate spread and a 38% argmin-flip rate, but that is a SELECTION counterfactual, not a DV. 2 arms x 20 seeds, paired WITHIN seed, differing ONLY in ScaffoldedSD054OnboardingConfig.scaffold_strict_goal_isolation (landed ree-v3 bd66d67f77, default False). Both arms build config from experiments/_lib/baselines/stageh_strict_goal_isolation.py so the single-variable claim holds by construction. CONFIG ANCHOR: V3-EXQ-603q ARM_BASE_IA_ONLY, truncated after Stage-H (P1/P2 dropped -- they run after the frozen stages and cannot inform a Stage-H DV). stage0_enabled + hazard_stage_enabled + feed_harm_stream + train_harm_pathway all ON: without z_goal formation the goal term is inert and the comparison vacuous (the triage's five inert exceptions), and without harm-pathway training the harm cost is a random constant (603i) so survival is unreachable at any budget. SEEDS=20 NOT the family-standard 3, and this is the load-bearing design decision: decomposing 603q's Stage-H episode lengths gives 93% of variance BETWEEN seeds (29.3 vs 8.1 within), so episodes/seed is not a precision lever and seeds are; and 603q's own within-seed arm delta had SD 51.4 against a mean of 23.3, so at n=3 SE_delta ~30 on a ~38-step baseline -- unfalsifiable either way. At n=20, 2*SE ~23.0 steps, under the pre-registered 25-step ceiling, and ~= the measured effect of the FULL escape-affordance bridge, so a null rules out a goal-term effect as large as an entire validated mechanism. Holds while SD_delta<=55.9 (9% margin over 603q). PRE-REGISTERED BOTH DIRECTIONS: outcome PASS = an ANSWER was reached, of either kind -- effect detected (|mean_delta| >= max(2*SE, 5.0 steps)) OR an adequately-powered null (2*SE <= 25.0). The null is recorded as PASS deliberately so it reads as the informative outcome that DISCHARGES the isolation worry, not as a failed run. FAIL only when no answer was reachable: substrate_not_ready_requeue (a readiness precondition unmet) or underpowered_null_more_seeds_required -- NEVER a substrate verdict. Regime-conditioned readiness gate (experiments/_lib/precondition_gate.py, applies_to): goal_term_live_in_stageh applies to ARM_LEGACY only, strict_isolation_applied to ARM_STRICT only -- asserting either on the other arm would make it structurally un-passable (the V3-EXQ-785 lesson). Top-level non_degenerate additionally requires BOTH arms green because the estimand is PAIRED (a green STRICT with a red LEGACY answers nothing); this is a tightening for a paired design, not the 785 defect, since there is no independent per-arm finding to vacate. DV-SYMMETRY: DV = mean Stage-H episode length, invariant under order-preserving changes to the E3 cost (broadcast constant / monotone rescaling). The manipulation is NOT invariant: goal_proximity is PER-CANDIDATE, and the triage measured spread 0.1022 and a 38% argmin flip where a broadcast constant would give exactly 0 and 0. Neither arm is structurally vacuous. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout is the paired strict-ON-vs-OFF Stage-H survival delta; NO landed manifest carries a strict-ON arm (the knob landed 2026-07-27 default-False and all 78 scaffold importers ran the legacy path -- verified by grep across experiments/ and evidence/experiments/), so it is unrecoverable by reanalysis and must be run. MINT-AS-YOU-GO: cells emitted reuse-eligible with include_driver_script_in_hash=False so a successor's different driver can reuse them. REPRODUCIBILITY: comparison is within-seed AND within-process -- the scaffold curriculum is not reproducible across processes; confirmed again in this session's two smokes (seed 42 ARM_LEGACY Stage-H mean 11.8 then 13.4). NOTE a concurrent session has an UNCOMMITTED scaffold edit adding scaffold_env_layout_seed (unseeded CausalGridWorld construction is the residual entropy source); once landed it would let both arms share an env layout per seed and cut the arm x seed interaction that drives this experiment's seed count -- a worthwhile successor, not depended on here. Smoke PASS (self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue on dry budgets, as designed; manipulation verified biting: LEGACY goal_weight=1.000/e1_gc=True/goal_live=True vs STRICT 0.000/False/False).

items.title: SD-MEL-PRODUCER validation, C4 measurable: graded, above-reference, LEARNABLE waking MEL from a non-converging world
items.note: SUPERSEDES V3-EXQ-798. Same scientific question, same instrument, same arm ladder; the only changes are the ones needed to make C4 -- the anti-artifact learnability criterion, the sole reason a noise control arm exists, and the driver's own declared discriminating DV -- MEASURABLE AT ALL, plus the routing guard that stops an unreadable C4 masquerading as a measured verdict. VALIDATES A TEST-BED, NOT A CLAIM: experiment_purpose=diagnostic, claim_ids=[] -- PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING. A PASS licenses the SEPARATE, still-gated ecological end-to-end MECH-180 run; it is not itself MECH-180 evidence. WHY 798a EXISTS (adjudicated 2026-07-27, session elated-shamir-5ef201; WORKSPACE_STATE 2026-07-27T23:02Z; pinned comment in ree-v3/tests/contracts/test_dead_z_goal_stream_lint.py, ree-v3 a976585ed7). 798 landed FAIL/non_contributory label producer_graded_but_not_learnable (manifest v3_exq_798_sdmelproducer_graded_nonconverging_world_20260723T081627Z_v3): readiness PASSED, C1 2/3, C2 2/3, C3 3/3, C4 fail. THREE DEFECTS. (1) C4 WAS UNREADABLE BY CONSTRUCTION, not by bad luck: _decay_frac needs >=5 samples in bin[0] and bin[N-1]; SSL_BIN_EDGES=(2,5,12) puts bin 3 at steps_since_world_rule_shift>12; C4 read only ARM_3_HIGH and ARM_4_NOISE and BOTH ran at world_rule_shift_interval=10, where the counter cycles 0..9 (causal_grid_world._maybe_shift_world_rule resets it on each fire). Landed bin counts {0:270,1:270,2:360,3:0} on all three seeds of both arms -- deterministic. The arms C4 did NOT read confirm the mechanism: interval 60 -> bin 3 held 705 (decay 0.260/0.103/0.361), interval 25 -> 432 (0.033/0.092/0.203). (2) THE NOISE CONTROL WAS NOT ELEVATED: noise_control_at_least_as_elevated also failed -- ARM_4_NOISE mel 2.36e-05 < ARM_3_HIGH mel 3.58e-05 at NOISE_SIGMA=0.05, so even a populated bin 3 would have compared a graded arm against a WEAKER control. (3) THE ROUTING IGNORED READABILITY: evaluate() took the producer_graded_but_not_learnable branch on (c1 and c2 and not c4) without consulting c4_readable, so 798's manifest asserts an 'ARTIFACT WARNING ... does NOT decay under training' about a quantity never measured, while its own learnability_bins_populated precondition records met:false -- the manifest contradicts itself. DO NOT read 798's evidence_direction_note as evidence about learnability. A LATENT FOURTH GAP was found while repairing the grid: 798 did not cover C1 pass + C2 pass + C3 fail + C4 pass, which fell through to producer_ineffective, contradicting C1/C2 passing. FIX 1 (defect 1) -- CYCLE-QUARTILE BINNING. PE is binned by POSITION WITHIN THE SHIFT CYCLE, q = min(3, 4*counter//interval), instead of against fixed absolute edges. Reachability then follows from the DESIGN rather than from a coincidence of which intervals are in the ladder: every quartile of a cycle of length I is non-empty for any I >= 4, at EVERY interval. _assert_quartile_reachability() PROVES it in-script from the pre-registered ARMS table at import, before any compute is spent, and also asserts the C4 pair share an interval and that each control has depth 0 and sigma > 0 -- it raises rather than running a doomed grid. Quartiles also mean the same PHASE at every rate, so the decay-vs-rate profile is directly comparable. 798's ABSOLUTE binning is STILL RECORDED at its own edges (2,5,12) as *_pe_by_ssl_bin / learn_decay_frac_abs_bins: a ROBUSTNESS DIAGNOSTIC ONLY that enters NO criterion, so a reader can check the repaired C4 is not itself an artifact of the new scheme. The smoke shows both at once on ARM_3_HIGH -- quartile counts {0:45,1:30,2:45,3:30} readable, 798's abs-bin counts {0:45,1:45,2:60,3:0} still empty. FIX 2 (defect 1, aliasing) -- C4 ANCHORED WHERE RE-LEARNING IS PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE. Making bin 3 reachable at interval 10 is necessary but not sufficient: at interval 10 the model gets at most 9 steps between shifts, so a null decay there ALIASES 'the structure is not re-learnable' with 'there was no time to re-learn it' (verdict aliasing, GOV-FANOUT-1 step 4). C4_ANCHOR_ARM is therefore PRE-REGISTERED as ARM_1_LOW (interval 60), the arm with the most re-learning headroom, where 798's own unread data shows the top bin held 705 samples; a null there is an unaliased negative. The anchor is fixed before the run and is NOT selected from its outcomes. The decay of EVERY arm is reported as learn_decay_by_arm/by-interval as a corroborating diagnostic (genuine load should decay MORE as the window lengthens; noise is flat at every rate) -- reported, not a criterion, no threshold fitted to it. Smoke profile is already monotone in the predicted direction: interval 60 -> 0.629, 25 -> 0.500, 10 -> 0.373. FIX 3 (defect 2) -- CONTROL MATCHED IN INTERVAL, CALIBRATED IN SIGMA, AND SELECTED BY A PRE-REGISTERED RULE. The noise arms move to the ANCHOR's interval (60) so their quartile bins are structurally identical to the arm C4 compares them against; depth 0 keeps the schedule firing (counter defined) while nothing is ever re-learnable. Sigma is derived from 798's LANDED measurement under a model stated BEFORE the run, not fitted after it: observation noise enters an L2 residual quadratically, so PE contribution ~ sigma^2; reaching the worst-seed ARM_1_LOW elevation (seed 456: 1.82e-05 vs the control's 0.65e-05 at sigma 0.05) needs ~2.8x, i.e. sigma ~0.084. TWO control arms are run, NOISE_SIGMA_LO=0.12 and NOISE_SIGMA_HI=0.24 (4x the PE contribution), with the PRE-REGISTERED selection rule: the C4 control is the LOWEST-sigma noise arm whose MEL is at least the anchor's on EVERY seed -- the most STRINGENT fair control available. Two points remove the knife-edge left by extrapolating a single sigma, and record a sigma->MEL calibration curve for successors. Overshoot is CONSERVATIVE for C4 (decay_frac is a relative drop, so more noise cannot manufacture decay in the control), which is why the chosen failure direction is 'too elevated'. Achieved ratios against BOTH ARM_1_LOW (gating) and ARM_3_HIGH (reported) are emitted as noise_elevation_ratios, not tuned. EXPECTATION TO WATCH: the smoke put LO's absolute noise contribution near 2e-05 against a worst-seed requirement of ~1.8e-05, i.e. marginal -- HI at 4x is the margin, and the selection rule will fall through to it if LO does not clear. FIX 4 (defect 3) -- ROUTING GUARD. c4_measurable = c4_bins_readable AND c4_control_fair. When false NO C4-dependent branch may be taken; the run routes to the explicit terminal label c4_unreadable_requeue whose note states which of C1/C2/C3 nonetheless stand and prints the achieved calibration so the re-queue is exact. The fairness leg gates as well as the readability leg: a C4 PASS won against an under-elevated control is untrustworthy, and conflating 'the control was unfair' with 'the load is an artifact' is precisely the class of error 798 committed. The grid is now EXHAUSTIVE over all sixteen C1..C4 combinations, closing the latent fourth gap with a new branch producer_graded_learnable_but_settles (C1+C2+C4 pass, C3 fail). Z_GOAL DELIBERATELY NOT WIRED. 798 has a confirmed dead z_goal stream (active_frac=0.000, writer_calls=0) and it was adjudicated NON_CONTRIBUTORY on verified grounds: the E3 goal term is gated on goal_state.is_active() (e3_selector.py:1180-1188); the E1 goal-conditioning path is gated on is_active() too (agent.py:4844-4859), so E1 receives z_goal=None, identical to the flag being off; update_residue, which produces the DV e3_prediction_error, has no goal reference; and _make_agent(env) is arm-independent, so the inert knobs are structurally arm-symmetric. Wiring update_z_goal would ACTIVATE the E3 goal term and E1 conditioning, changing action selection and hence the trajectories the PE is computed over -- 798a would stop being comparable to 798/701c/718a and the C4 repair would be confounded with a behaviour change. So _make_agent is byte-identical to 798's and the dead-z_goal lint is opted out of EXPLICITLY (DEAD_Z_GOAL_STREAM_EXEMPT with the adjudication cited) rather than silenced by a config change; the pinned corpus fire count is unmoved. (Precision: the SD-024 hazard is CONDITIONAL -- update_z_goal's accumulate_benefit call is itself gated on config.residue.benefit_terrain_live_producer, default False, which 798 does not set, so adding the call alone would not populate benefit_rbf_field nor un-zero the SD-025 curiosity bonus. The unconditional non-comparability comes from the E3/E1 paths.) ALSO REPAIRED IN PASSING, same defect family: (a) the R2 readiness precondition reported min(per-seed drop) while its met quantified over a SEED FRACTION -- a mean-vs-quantifier mismatch the indexer recomputes against; it now reports conv_seed_fraction against SEED_PASS_FRAC, the exact statistic met tests. (b) C3 was never readable in 798 (late bin empty on 3/3 seeds, criteria_non_degenerate.C3=false, silent fallback to an overall-mean comparison); under quartile binning it is genuinely readable, with the semantic shift documented -- 'long after' now means late in the arm's OWN cycle, which is the meaningful reading for a rate-graded ladder. (c) 798's manifest recorded elapsed_seconds null (validate_recording --strict always-core gap); the clock is now threaded through the stamper. (d) the arm_cell config_slice now DECLARES the binning (798's did not), so a future consumer cannot false-HIT these fingerprints and silently read bin means computed under a different scheme. GOV-REUSE-1. Decisive readout: learn_decay_frac -- post-shift PE decay under training on the rule-shift arms, compared against a matched, at-least-as-elevated noise control. Checked v3_exq_798_...20260723T081627Z_v3 (substrate_hash 99838572791733e1), the only landed manifest carrying the knob at all. PARTIALLY recoverable and therefore NOT recoverable for the decisive comparison: the graded side exists for ARM_1_LOW and ARM_2_MED, but learn_decay_frac is null for BOTH arms C4 read, no noise control was run at any readable interval, and no control at any sigma reached the anchor's MEL. The control side of the comparison exists in no recorded run -> run. The full ladder is re-run rather than a C4-only minimal probe because the interpretation grid routes on C1..C4 JOINTLY and this manifest supersedes 798's. DV-SYMMETRY PER ARM (Step 3.5). ARM_0_NONE/ARM_1_LOW/ARM_2_MED/ARM_3_HIGH: DV is mean per-step e3 prediction_error, an L2 residual between E2's ACTION-CONDITIONED prediction and the observed next z_world; the manipulation re-permutes the action->displacement map, which changes that conditional mapping, so the DV is NOT invariant under it -- a conditional-prediction argument, not a distributional one (even a uniform-random policy in a symmetric world leaves the trajectory DISTRIBUTION unchanged while breaking the learned per-action mapping the residual is computed against). ARM_4_NOISE_LO/ARM_5_NOISE_HI: the DV IS invariant in the trivial sense -- additive observation noise raises an L2 residual BY ARITHMETIC. That is deliberate and is precisely their role as NEGATIVE CONTROLS calibrating what an artifact looks like; they are NOT evidence for anything and are excluded from the C1 ladder. Learnability DV (PE by cycle quartile under a TRAINING model): NOT an arithmetic identity for either family -- noise yields flat quartiles, re-learnable structure yields decaying ones. This is the discriminating DV. MEASUREMENT (unchanged from 798): fixed STEP budget, not fixed episode count -- shift rate SHORTENS episodes (798 measured 33.5 -> 18.4 steps NONE vs HIGH), which would give each arm a different episode-phase mix; mean_episode_length is reported per arm. P1 stays FROZEN for comparability with 701c/718a; P2 enables the world-forward optimiser because a frozen model cannot re-learn. SMOKE PASS 2026-07-27 (twice, deterministic): 6/6 arms, 6 verdict lines, progress denominator 80 throughout, dry-run manifest correctly relocated out of evidence/, sentinel written, validate_experiments --strict --paths OK on all 15 checks, validate_recording --strict COMPLETE. C4 read MEASURABLE (bins True, fair control True) -- the exact thing 798 could not do. Smoke routes correctly to substrate_not_ready_requeue because its 2-episode P0 leaves R1 unmet, which is the readiness gate working. COMPUTE: 6 arms x 3 seeds = 18 cells at 798's per-cell budget (15 cells / 480 min) -> ~580 min.
